How the tests were run

Browser checksAutomated with Puppeteer driving Microsoft Edge (headless) against the production build of the frontend and the real backend on an in-memory MongoDB, on separate ports. Any request to the normal dev ports is blocked, so no real database is touched.

Step 4 — Start/stop timer

Step 6 — Weekly timesheet

Hours per project per day, Monday to Sunday, counted in the user's own time zone (daylight saving days are 23 or 25 hours long). An entry that crosses midnight is split between the days it touches. Also covered by this step: the entries list's overlap filter (in entries.test.js), used so a timesheet cell lists the entry behind it.
